# thyme v0.1 — pre-release

The first public pre-release of **thyme**, a fixed-topology, single-host C++17
real-time data-plane runtime.

This is a pre-release: interfaces and generated artifacts may still change.

## Highlights

- **Generation-time topology.** `graph.yaml` → `gen_graph` → static, byte-stable
  `generated/` wiring, with a `--check` gate against hand edits.
- **Typed channel semantics.** `latest`, `queue`, `broadcast`, and lease-backed
  large frames are selected and validated at compile time.
- **Shared-memory data plane.** `SpscRing`, `ShmSpscRing`, `ShmSpmcRing`,
  `LatestSlot`, and PinnedSlot leases, with futex-based cross-process waits.
- **Recording, triggered capture, replay, and probing** as first-class tools,
  including `.thyme.bin` packages, integrity manifests, MCAP export, and
  read-only SHM inspection.
- **Single-host multi-process runtime.** Supervisor/role split, health and
  status surfaces, session lease, and producer gates.
- **Observability.** Perf log, `ProcSampler`, host sampler, metrics exporter,
  Grafana/Foxglove dashboards, and channel observability audits.
- **Documentation and tests.** English architecture/usage/reference docs and a
  270-case test suite, with GitHub Actions CI.

## Quick start

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
ctest --test-dir build -L mr_gate --output-on-failure

# Full suite
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
```

See [README.md](https://github.com/shuzhang2016/thyme/blob/main/README.md) and
[ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/shuzhang2016/thyme/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md).

## Scope and known limitations

- Single host / single OS instance only. There is no cross-machine network
  transport (SOME/IP, DDS-over-network, or equivalent).
- `SCHED_DEADLINE` has been evaluated but is not enabled; FIFO + rate-monotonic
  priorities remain the default.
- Target-board/HIL validation, long-duration soak testing, and platform services
  such as diagnostics/UCM/time synchronization are outside this repository.
- C++17; Linux is the primary target (x86_64 and AArch64).
